text: Pink eve is an inflammation of which eve tissue?

summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a question from a written test. The header indicates that it is the 12th question out of 12. The question asks, "Pink eye is an inflammation of which eye tissue?" Below the question, there are four multiple-choice options: Iris, Cornea, Crystalline lens, and Conjunctiva. At the bottom of the screen, there is a red button labeled "Main Menu." The background is primarily dark blue, with the question and options presented in a white box.
